fact: Harare Institute of Technology hosted a two-day Zimbabwe University Libraries Consortium workshop training librarians from more than 22 state universities on assistive technologies (screen reader, Braille and reading devices), with equipment funded by a USD 220,000 grant secured by the consortium for its member libraries (HIT, 2026-06-10).

fact: Ministry spokesperson Taungana Ndoro said the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education is scaling up inclusive education for learners with disabilities through assistive tools, accessible buildings and specialised teacher training.

The Herald reports the government-commissioned National Information Access Centre at Zimbabwe Open University includes an inclusive library with assistive technologies, and the vice chancellor says it has smart boards and assistive devices for students with disabilities.
